visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a black jacket is seen in a dark subway environment, looking startled as the camera pans to a chaotic crowd running through a station. The lighting is dim with green emergency signs visible. (2) A man in a dark coat stands inside a moving subway car, looking intently at something off-camera while holding a long sword; sparks and yellow energy effects emanate from his movements. (3) Another man in a suit is shown in a close-up looking at his smartphone in a crowded train car, his expression shifting from calm to shock. (4) A series of rapid cuts introduces multiple characters: a woman with a bow, a man with glasses, and others in battle-worn clothing within dark tunnels. (5) Scenes of combat follow, featuring characters fighting CGI lizard-like monsters in dimly lit industrial or tunnel settings. (6) A sunset scene on an elevated orange bridge shows two men in a physical struggle, one holding the other over the edge. (7) The final phase shows a movie poster graphic with six main characters standing in a subway car, followed by release date text over a dark background.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 當這個世界開始崩壞 你會選擇相信誰？ [Logo]: 綜合電影與美的分享. (2) [Subtitle]: 《全知讀者視角》 不只是奇幻動作片. (3) [Subtitle]: 更是一場 角色群像的心理戰. (4) [Subtitle]: 安孝燮飾演的金獨子 是個孤獨的讀者. (5) [Subtitle]: 某天卻發現 他最愛的小說竟然成真. (6) [Subtitle]: 而李敏鎬飾演的劉眾赫 在小說裡是主角. (7) [Subtitle]: 他強大到幾乎無需懷疑. (8) [Subtitle]: 卻也危險到 讓人無法完全信任. (9) [Slogan]: 蔡秀彬·申承浩 NANA·JISOO. (10) [Subtitle]: 每個角色都有 自己的秘密、選擇與目標. (11) [Subtitle]: 有的人想掌控局面 有的人想保住性命. (12) [Subtitle]: 而有的人 只想活著看到明天. (13) [Subtitle]: 這部電影的精彩之處 不只在龐大的世界觀和炫目的特效. (14) [Subtitle]: 更在每場戰鬥 都拍得極具張力. (15) [Subtitle]: 動作場面節奏精準 演員反應真實. (16) [Subtitle]: 每一場任務都是 體能與情緒的雙重考驗. (17) [Subtitle]: 無論是任務設計 角色配置還是節奏安排. (18) [Subtitle]: 都展現出了 細膩的電影語言. (19) [Subtitle]: 由六大韓流巨星聯手打造. (20) [Subtitle]: 最華麗也最殘酷的 異世界冒險. (21) [Slogan]: 全知讀者視角 OMISCIENT READER. (22) [Slogan]: 7月23日週三晚場起 全台上印. (23) [Subtitle]: 這一次 沒有人能獨自存活！

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a serious, professional male narration over a low-frequency synth pad. A sharp 'whoosh' SFX triggers as the narrator asks a rhetorical question. (2) Orchestral strings enter in a minor key, accompanied by a rhythmic electronic pulse. A metallic 'shing' sound signifies a sword being drawn, followed by a low-frequency 'impact' boom. (3) The tempo of the music increases; short percussive hits are layered to match fast visual cuts. A faint sound of subway wind and distant crowd panic is audible beneath the narration. (4) High-frequency digital 'sparkle' SFX appear during energy visual effects. The narrator's pitch remains steady but adopts a more urgent cadence. (5) Cinematic percussion intensifies, featuring heavy taiko-style drum hits and brass stabs. Friction sounds and thuds represent physical combat. (6) The music reaches a crescendo with a sustained orchestral chord, then abruptly ends on a clean hard cut as the final release date information is narrated.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a promotional trailer for the movie 'Omniscient Reader'. It uses high-energy cinematic music and fast-paced editing to showcase the film's star-studded cast and action-packed fantasy premise, aiming to build anticipation for its July 23rd release.
